title: 第1349章 黑色的香囊第1348章 争抢璞玉
slug: 我都无敌了要你这系统有何用
content_zh:
随着时间慢慢推移！
当琴诗雅嗅到罗睺腰间黑色香囊，所散发出的淡淡深幽雅香之后！
常年以清冷示人，喜怒不形于色，好似世间万物都难以引动其分毫心神的琴诗涵，她此刻心头突然冒出一丝浅浅的悸动！
一种难以言喻的微小舒适感，在琴诗雅的心头缓缓舒展开来！
从今天开始就一直萦绕在她心头的，那股小小的不宁，在琴诗雅闻到这股深幽雅香之后，居然缓缓消散于无形！
其实，是青墨特制的这个香囊，让琴诗雅那难得的鼎炉体质，出现了些许轻微的愉悦反应，只不过她本人却并没有往这个方面去想而已！
“你叫罗睺？！”
“晚辈罗睺，拜见太瑶宫主！”
依旧让人看起来谦逊有礼的罗睺，在听到琴诗雅那清冷的询问之后，他当即不卑不亢的，对其拱手深深行礼！
“你天赋极佳，完全有资格拜入我太瑶神宫修行！”
“宫主抬爱，晚辈惶恐！”
“想好拜谁为师了吗？本宫看这些长老们，可都想抢着当你师尊呢！”
“各位长老们对晚辈的看重，晚辈铭感五内！只是…晚辈阅历尚浅，对于各位长老们的厚爱，晚辈…一时之间不知该如何选择！”
罗睺此时故意让自己的语气里，带着些许不易察觉的慌乱，好似他真被刚才那些长老们的表现给吓到了一般！
看到眼前不过十岁左右的孩童，此时眼底深处闪过的慌乱，身为太瑶神宫宫主的琴诗雅，并未觉得有任何的异常！
相反，因为罗睺腰间香囊所散发出的，特别针对她鼎炉体质的深幽雅香，琴诗雅此时居然对眼前的小正太，起了一丝丝想要将其收为徒弟的念想！
而位于罗睺身旁的那些太瑶神宫的长老们，此刻他们的眼中同样不由自主的，闪过一抹惊慌之色！
如今宫主亲自现身，她该不会也想收罗睺为徒吧？！
“罗睺！既然你目前不知该如何抉择，那本宫主帮你选择如何？！”
“你可愿意？！”

琴诗雅此时的声音很轻，很冷，依旧让人听不出半点的情感，好似她会切身实意的为罗睺所考量一般！
“弟子初来乍到，能得宫主赏识，由宫主帮弟子选择师尊，实在是弟子之幸，一切任凭宫主做主！”
罗睺此时再次拱手行礼，并且脑袋低垂，完全就是一副乖巧听话的模样！
看到罗睺此时依旧谦逊至极，不因自身那难得的好天赋，而有任何的骄傲自满，依旧彬彬有礼，对于眼前所有长辈全部恭敬有加的模样！
刚才都渴望抢着当他师尊的那些长老们，现在若不是顾及宫主在此，他们恐怕都忍不住直接动手抢人了！
这么好的徒弟，那可是打着灯笼都难找啊！
“既如此，那你拜本宫为师吧？！”
听到这话！
周围那些长老们一直悬着的心，终于还是死了！
琴诗雅作为神宫之主，多年来深居简出，对于神宫每隔一段时间，就广开山门收徒之事向来漠不关心，完全任由神宫那些长老们商量安排！
而且距离她上次主动收徒，都已经过去了不知多少年月！
这…他们太瑶神宫好不容易，来了一块难得的‘璞玉’，这时候你作为宫主就出现了？！
刚才还说帮罗睺挑选合适的师尊？！
这会就挑到自己头上了是吧？！
content_en:
As time goes by!
When Qin Shiya smelled the faint, deep and elegant fragrance exuded by the black sachet on Luohu's waist!
Qin Shihan, who has been showing off her coldness all year round, with no expression of joy or anger, as if nothing in the world can arouse her mind at all, a slight throbbing suddenly appeared in her heart at this moment!
An indescribable sense of comfort slowly spreads out in Qin Shiya's heart!
The little restlessness that had been lingering in her heart since today actually slowly dissipated after Qin Shiya smelled this deep and elegant fragrance!
In fact, it was Qing Mo's specially made sachet that gave Qin Shiya's rare cauldron physique a slightly pleasant reaction, but she didn't think about it in this regard!
"Your name is Luohu?!"
"Junior Luo Hu, pay your respects to Palace Master Taiyao!"
Luo Hu, who still looked humble and courteous, after hearing Qin Shiya's cold inquiry, he immediately saluted her deeply without being humble or arrogant!
"You are extremely talented, and you are fully qualified to join my Taiyao Shrine to practice!"
"The palace master shows his love, and the younger generation is frightened!"
"Have you decided who you want to be your master? I see that these elders all want to be your master!"
"The respect that the elders have for the juniors, I deeply appreciate it! It's just that...the juniors have little experience, so for the great love of the elders, the juniors...don't know how to choose for a moment!"
At this time, Luo Hu deliberately made his tone slightly panicked, as if he was really frightened by the performance of the elders just now!
Seeing the panic flashing deep in the eyes of the child who was only about ten years old in front of her, Qin Shiya, the master of Taiyao Shrine, did not feel anything unusual!
On the contrary, because of the deep and elegant fragrance emitted by the sachet on Luohu's waist, which was especially suitable for her physique, Qin Shiya actually had the slightest desire to accept the young lady in front of her as her disciple!
The elders of Taiyao Shrine who were beside Luo Hu also had a flash of panic in their eyes at this moment!
Now that the palace master has appeared in person, does she also want to take Rahu as her disciple? !
"Luo Hu! Since you don't know how to choose at the moment, how about I help you choose?!"
"Are you willing?!"
Qin Shiya's voice at this time was very soft and cold, and she still couldn't hear the slightest emotion, as if she would consider Luo Hu sincerely!
"This is my first time here. It's a great honor for me to be appreciated by the Palace Master, and the Palace Master can help me choose my master. Everything is up to the Palace Master!"
At this time, Luo Hu bowed his hands again and bowed his head, looking completely obedient!
Seeing that Luo Hu was still extremely humble at this time, not showing any pride or complacency because of his rare talent, he was still polite and respectful to all the elders in front of him!
Those elders who were all eager to become his master just now, if they hadn't taken into account that the palace master was here now, they might not be able to help but grab him directly!
Such a good apprentice is hard to find even with a lantern!
"In that case, then you will accept me as your teacher, right?!"
Hear this!
The hearts of the elders around me have finally died!
As the Lord of the Shrine, Qin Shiya has lived in seclusion for many years. She has always been indifferent to the fact that the Shrine opens sects to recruit disciples every once in a while, and completely allows the elders of the Shrine to discuss and arrange it!
And it’s been countless years since she last took the initiative to recruit a disciple!
This... their Taiyao Shrine finally came to a rare piece of 'raw jade'. At this time, you appear as the palace master? !
Did you just say that you would help Luo Hu choose a suitable master? !
Now it’s your fault, right? !
